Variants.Content: The inn provides a night of firelight to those who do not have a castle, and also houses the most unreliable eyes and ears. Wealthy travelers can buy clean mattresses and hot water, but most poor people can only sleep beside the stables; shopkeepers must respect the passing noble flags, but also be wary of drunkards, thieves and arrears soldiers of accounts.
